topics.label: Soccer live gamestate
topics.description: Live soccer game-state updates published by GCD into Pulsar (use2). Mirrored from Trading's MSK Kafka topic `trading.soccer.nxt.sgt` (staging) by the GCD Kafka→Pulsar sink connector. Payload: protobuf (`GameStateOutbound.Api`).

topics.label: Live mappings
topics.description: Live ID/RAMP mapping events between sportsbook IDs and provider IDs. Mirrored from MFSL UKI Kafka `livedata.mappings`. Payload: protobuf (`MappingDeserializer`); may surface as hex / lossy UTF-8 here until the mapping `.proto` is bundled.

topics.label: Competition pre-match stats
topics.description: Competition-level (league / tournament) pre-match statistics for soccer. Mirrored from Confluent Cloud `trading.nxt.competition.soccer.prematch.stats` (staging). Payload: JSON with optional non-JSON byte prefix.

topics.label: Fixture pre-match stats
topics.description: Fixture-level (per-match) pre-match statistics for soccer. Mirrored from Confluent Cloud `trading.nxt.fixture.soccer.prematch.stats` (staging). Payload: JSON.
